summary: Palo Alto Networks Next-Gen Trust Security, cloud certificate lifecycle and private PKI management (formerly CyberArk Certificate Manager SaaS, Venafi TLS Protect Cloud).
value: All of the company’s certificates, including unknown ones, are in one inventory.
Services do not go down because of an expired certificate: renewal is automatic.
Certificates are issued and replaced by policy, without manual work.
simple: Cloud certificate lifecycle management and private PKI (successor to CyberArk Certificate Manager SaaS, formerly Venafi TLS Protect Cloud); not part of Idira — it belongs to Palo Alto Networks network security. Discovers public and private certificates on firewalls, remote access gateways, servers and Kubernetes clusters and keeps a single inventory with owners, expiry dates and certificate authorities. Automatically issues, renews, deploys and validates certificates and works with multiple certificate authorities; a cloud private PKI replaces your own CA servers (ACME, EST, SCEP). Helps prepare for the move to post-quantum algorithms. Starter / Standard / Enterprise / Max editions — the classes are the same.
classification: Outside the Idira brand, same vendor, the CLM class.
SSH Manager and CodeSign Manager are separate products and are not included.
